 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Naomi Osaka normally reserves her walk-on outfits for Grand Slams, but tennis fans should not be overly surprised that she had a customized look for the home crowd at the Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo.
 Osaka has been in the news lately for non-tennis reasons as she recently posted a thoughtful message upon turning 29.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Her ex-boyfriend Cordae also indirectly discussed their 2025 breakup in his new rap song "Helpless."
 MORE: Introspective Naomi Osaka posts lengthy message on 29th birthday 
 What Osaka wore
 Tennis – U.S. Open – Flushing Meadows, New York, United States – September 5, 2026 Japan's Naomi Osaka arrives on court ahead of her third round match against Belgium's Elise Mertens IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters/Geoff Burke Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters (Reuters)
 According to tennis insider Jessica Schiffer , it was a "custom kimono by Hana Yagi." Yagi, who worked with Osaka in the past including at the 2026 Wimbledon Championships , is known for using and reworking retired "Japanese retired ceremonial garments."
 The kimono had a bird design printed throughout the fabric and ruffles at the edges to mimic bird feathers.
 MORE: Naomi Osaka's ex Cordae seemingly addresses breakup in new song 'Helpless' 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Osaka earned big win
 In addition to dazzling the fans with the kimono, Osaka delivered a big win. This was a tricky matchup against Jasmine Paolini. Though Paolini has battled injuries most of the season, she is a gritty opponent that fights to the very last point.
 That was evident as the match was decided by a second set tiebreak won by Osaka, 7-4. Final score was 6-3, 7-6(4).
 Paolini won their only previous meeting at the 2025 Miami Open in three sets after dropping the first set.
 Osaka's next match is on Thursday against World No. 144 Mia Pohankova from Slovakia.
